args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring and tests expect banker's rounding, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
e.g. 2.665 rounds to 2.66 as required by FIN-212.

args.body:
## Problem
`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212, but `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so the nightly build failed.

## Fix
Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on `fix-bankers-rounding` (sha `08d3cd5986`) passed.
